_comment: Ask-Report.ps1 reads this file: which SERVER index and which SQL-script index belong with a CLIENT
project index, for the questions that read more than one (round-trip, lands-where: server + SQL;
consumers, feeds-from: SQL; crosses-boundary: the other side, optional).
Each path was VERIFIED with the engine's resolve-dbs when written, never guessed:
Ask-Report re-checks at run time that the manifest still configures the server and SQL index named
here, and stops naming this file when it does not. sqlSection is the manifest section of the SQL
index, used only to print its reindex command when it is stale.
Add a project: one more object in pairs, each path checked with resolve-dbs first.
